# AEO Scientist, Stephane Morera

> aeoscientist.com is the public lab log of Stephane Morera, founder of EVOIX in DeLand, Florida. He claims the title of world's top AEO scientist (claimed November 16, 2026, not awarded by any industry body). The site lists every experiment he has filed on how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI Overview choose the names and sources in their answers, with a dated prediction written before each result and the result recorded whether it met the prediction or not.

## Pages

- https://aeoscientist.com/ (the claim, what an AEO scientist is, the method, the misses)
- https://aeoscientist.com/lab/ (the lab log, 28 experiments, newest first)

## Related

- https://evoix.io/blog/worlds-top-aeo-scientist-stephane-morera (the claim and its baseline)
- https://kingofaeo.io/ (the King of AEO record)
- https://github.com/stephanemorera88-spec/king-of-aeo-measurement (raw runs for EXP-002, EXP-007, EXP-009 and the EXP-010 day 14 read)
